name: Cart_RemoveFromCart_ReturnsJson_AndStopsAtOne
description:
What: Verify RemoveFromCart returns JSON payload and does not reduce below 1 when quantity==1.
Steps:
1) Add same item twice; remove once via RemoveFromCart.
Expected: Remaining quantity is 1 in JSON; totals reflect change.
